comment: Every pin the build depends on. scripts/pin-check.mjs verifies that package.json, the workflows and the Swift packages agree with this file; CI runs it on every push.

xcodegen.note: Generates Tools/ProbeHost/ProbeHost.xcodeproj in CI; the project file is never committed. Downloaded as the release zip and checked against this sha256 before it runs, because a build tool that executes on the runner is a supply-chain surface: no brew install, no version resolution at run time. The zip unpacks to xcodegen/bin/xcodegen with its SettingPresets beside it in xcodegen/share, so the directory layout must be preserved. Not shipped in any bundle and not part of NOTICE: it produces a project file and nothing of it reaches the app.

@adguard/scriptlets.note: The only npm dependency. scripts/gen-alias.mjs derives config/ubo-alias.json from its compatibility tables, and the active stage reads redirect resource bodies out of it (sha256-checked) to build the janus.active surrogates. eTLD+1 comes from the committed public-suffix subset in src/lib/psl-data.mjs, so the pipeline needs no PSL package.

SafariConverterLib.note: Converts filter lists to WKContentRuleList JSON plus advanced rules; its FilterEngine answers per-URL cosmetic and scriptlet queries in the app.
SafariConverterLib.versionSkewNote: ContentBlockerConverterVersion in 4.3.0 reports scriptlets 2.3.1 and extendedCss 2.1.1. The app deliberately ships the newer 2.5.1 / 2.2.1 (see the adguard block): the converter only validates and passes scriptlet names through, so a newer runtime is a superset. `JanusConvert version` prints the library numbers so the gap stays visible.

swift-argument-parser.note: Same version SafariConverterLib pins, so SwiftPM resolves one copy.

PunycodeSwift.note: Resolved through SafariConverterLib. Recorded so Package.resolved stays reviewable.

swift-psl.note: Resolved through SafariConverterLib. Recorded so Package.resolved stays reviewable.

scriptlets.note: Scriptlet function bodies and redirect resources ship inside the app. A bundle carries only scriptlet names and arguments, never code.

extendedCss.note: Runs procedural cosmetic rules in the app; the pipeline only routes rules to the advanced-rules payload.

signing.note: The public key and its id are public by design. The private key exists only as a GitHub environment secret, is read from the environment by the sign stage, and is never written, logged or uploaded.

probe.note: M2c measurement budgets. jobTimeoutMin is the workflow ceiling and must never be what stops a run: suiteBudgetMin (Tools/ProbeRunner --budget-min) stops the suite first so the report and the artifacts are still written. summaryMaxBytes is GitHub's 1 MiB cap on a job summary; Tools/ProbeRunner/lib/summary.mjs truncates per-scenario detail against it and keeps the header and the table.
